checks.description: Run a headless Copilot prompt and return the probe token.

checks.observed: Headless failure class command; exit 1, timed out=false, token observed=false.
checks.remediation: Inspect the bounded redacted excerpt, fix the reported CLI or skill problem, then rerun npm run test:live:execution.
checks.excerpt:
Error: Failed to load models
Error: error sending request for url (https://api.individual.githubcopilot.com/models): client error (Connect): dns error: error resolving DNS: failed to lookup address information: No address associated with hostname [ENOTFOUND]
Copilot could not retrieve the list of available models.
To resolve this, try the following:
  • If you set COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN, verify it is a user token with Copilot access, or unset it to use your Copilot CLI login
  • Start 'copilot' and run the '/login' command to re-authenticate
  • Run 'gh auth status' to check your current authentication status
  • If the problem persists, retry later or contact support with the Request ID above
